assessments.reasoning: The clause distinguishes logical module body and generated implementation-tool material in the physical export. It still defines procedural and class grammar productions. The host’s object-model semantics are a separate question.

limitations: The applicability is MS-VBAL revision 2.4, dated May 20, 2025. Specific Office application behavior, earlier and later revisions, and other Visual Basic lineages require separate evidence.
The scope excludes Begin/End appearing elsewhere, the grammar of generated module attributes, an Office serialization guarantee and the host application object model.
